About

Analyst. Problem Solver. Builder.

I’m a healthcare analyst and statistician with a passion for using data, automation, and technology to improve healthcare access, revenue cycle integrity, and operational efficiency. I’ve led teams, built analytics solutions, and worked across healthcare, technology, and operations. I’m also a lifelong learner, a STEM advocate, and a firm believer that complex systems can be made more human.
